name: Model Training Graphviz
description: Training-time preset for model architecture evidence overlays. The pattern is now a thin wrapper around model-graphviz renderController: model-graphviz owns evidence hover panels, edge type tags, phase/focus-driven node selection, related-node emphasis, hierarchy-aware focus, and drag pan / Command-wheel zoom without viewport jumping. This wrapper maps trainingEvidence and controller.setPhase() onto the shared base controller while preserving the training preview and product API.

examples.notes: Canonical preview synchronized from compute-graph-viewer/train/training-run-twin.js. It uses the real Qwen7B training architecture graph, parameter/state tensor inputs, edge tags, hover evidence, and phase-linked selection used by Training Run Explainable Twin.

classification: hybrid-pattern preset: DOM shell remains in the preview, while SVG graph geometry, hover panel rendering, edge tags, pan/zoom, and focus interaction math are owned by model-graphviz/pattern.js.

dataContract.graph: Same node/edge/cluster graph object accepted by model-graphviz.

relatedNodeIds: node ids to keep highlighted with this node

dataContract.hierarchy: Clusters may define parent, children, and nodes arrays; nodes may define parent. The shared model-graphviz controller uses these relationships for drill-down selection and ancestor/descendant emphasis.
dataContract.edgeTags: Edges may define tag, edgeType, edgeTypeLabel to render compact evidence labels through model-graphviz. Edges may also define sourceAnchor, targetAnchor, curve, and tagPosition when a fork/join needs stable branch routing.

useWhen: showing how a training phase maps to architecture nodes without moving the graph viewport
overlaying source/config/profiling evidence in hover panels or side evidence while graph nodes stay tensor/module/operator based
connecting right-side run steps, loss/MFU curves, or hardware evidence to architecture nodes
teaching Dense, MoE, MLA, DSA, router, expert, and LM Head training bottlenecks
allowedOverrides: graph data, node labels, cluster labels, edge tags, training evidence copy, and selected node ids
model-specific phase maps from training workflow names to graph node ids
viewport padding and initial selected node
model-graphviz renderController options such as evidenceMap, hover rendering, selected/related class names, and pan/zoom fit options
node fill colors through the base model-graphviz colormap only
source/config/profiling evidence as hover metadata or page-side evidence panels
forbiddenOverrides: reimplementing model node geometry outside model-graphviz
using an iframe page shell when the product needs direct phase-node linkage
moving the viewport when phase steps advance; selection should only change node and edge emphasis
dimming non-selected operators or tensor nodes with low opacity during phase changes
drawing tall source-evidence columns inside the architecture graph
using source files such as config.json or modeling.py as input/output tensor nodes
promoting training evidence priority or business severity into graph badges
using saturated blue borders as the main selected state in light mode
creating native title tooltips in addition to the custom hover panel
drawing edge tags or evidence badges from static HTML rather than model-graphviz renderer output
reintroducing a second local graph controller for hover, edge tags, pan/zoom, or related-node emphasis inside model-training-graphviz
agentReuseRule: Load model-graphviz/pattern.css and pattern.js first, then model-training-graphviz/pattern.css and pattern.js. Call PtoModelTrainingGraphvizPattern.render with a model-graphviz graph object plus trainingEvidence. The wrapper delegates to PtoModelGraphvizPattern.renderController and preserves controller.setPhase({nodeId, relatedNodeIds}) for training-step linkage. Do not refit or pan the graph when phases change, and do not duplicate base controller behavior locally.
